text: FAA guidance: if the loss of control link occurs, try to reestablish the control link; if not, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link. Manuals (DJI Matrice 210 V1): if RTH is triggered and within 20 m of the Home Point, it will land automatically; during RTH it hovers ~0.7 m above ground awaiting user confirmation; if farther than 20 m from the Home Point, it ascends to the pre-set RTH attitude and then flies to the Home Point. Incident reports: no usable evidence found for Autel EVO Max 4N or DJI Matrice 210 V1 incidents in the approved collection.
